resolved_finding: First revision joined owner release thread before checking owner disposal, hiding early successor entry. Independent real Linux inode-swap mutation passed both first-revision tests. Corrected constructor-success and immediate-entry assertions reject that same exclusion defect before entry.

early-entry-mutant-current.json rejects mutant for both exact final committed test hashes

git diff --check base..head passes; worktree clean

documentation_improvement.proposed_delta_integrated_in_parent_comm: Check owner disposal immediately when the successor acquires and enters, before joining the release thread. A join can let an early-entry defect wait for owner release and pass later assertions. Keep thread-completion and error assertions as separate cleanup checks.
documentation_improvement.durable_learning: Separate exclusion ordering from thread completion; joining before ordering assertions can conceal an exclusion regression.
documentation_improvement.evidence: Independent first-revision FALSE_PASS and final-revision rejection controls; direct changed test-source inspection.
documentation_improvement.stale_or_ambiguous_guidance_removed: The old strict elapsed lower bound did not prove mutual exclusion; the initial replacement also needed pre-join exclusion assertions.
documentation_improvement.remaining_uncertainty: Hosted exact-head Windows execution and overall#313 process-tree/reader/lease cleanup acceptance remain unverified.
